_readme: DO NOT EDIT normally. Curated starter APIs used by scripts/seed.py for the initial one-time build. All entries are real, well-documented services with public free access. The seed pipeline verifies every URL live before publishing, so facts are confirmed, not assumed.

seed.name: Open-Meteo
seed.description: Global weather forecast and historical weather data API for non-commercial use. Offers hourly and daily forecasts, air quality, and geocoding without requiring an API key.
seed.free_tier: Completely free for non-commercial use; no API key required. Commercial use requires a paid API subscription.
features: Hourly and daily weather forecasts up to 16 days
use_cases: A weather dashboard for a travel planning site
Historical climate analysis for a gardening app
An air-quality alert widget for smart home dashboards
A hiking conditions checker with hourly forecasts

seed.name: GitHub REST API
seed.description: Official REST interface to GitHub data: repositories, issues, pull requests, users, commits, and more. Unauthenticated requests are limited; authenticated requests get a much higher rate limit.
seed.free_tier: Free. 60 unauthenticated requests per hour per IP; 5,000 authenticated requests per hour with a free personal access token.
features: Full read/write access to repository data
Issues, pull requests, and commit history
use_cases: CI dashboards that track pull request status across repos
Changelog generators from release and commit data
Open-source contribution trackers and leaderboards
Automated issue triage and labeling bots

seed.name: REST Countries
seed.description: Free API providing information about world countries: names, capitals, populations, currencies, languages, flags, timezones and borders. No authentication required.
seed.free_tier: Completely free with no API key; reasonable rate limits apply.
features: Country profiles with capital, region and population
Flag images in SVG and PNG
use_cases: Country pickers with flags and currency data for checkout forms
Geography quiz apps and educational tools
Travel briefing pages with timezone and language info
Data enrichment for international user profiles

seed.name: Frankfurter
seed.description: Exchange rates API published by the European Central Bank. Converts between 30+ world currencies with historical rates back to 1999. No API key required.
seed.free_tier: Completely free for all use; no API key or registration required.
features: Latest and historical ECB reference rates
use_cases: Currency converters for pricing pages
Historical exchange rate charts for finance blogs
Multi-currency invoice calculators for freelancers
Price normalization in comparison shopping tools

seed.name: PokeAPI
seed.description: Comprehensive RESTful API for Pokemon data: species, abilities, moves, types, items and game information. Free and open with no authentication.
seed.free_tier: Completely free; fair-use rate limit of 300 requests per resource per day is requested by the project.
features: Full Pokemon species and stat data
use_cases: Pokedex web and mobile apps
Team builder tools for Pokemon games
Type matchup calculators and battle simulators
Pokemon-themed trivia and learning games

seed.name: Hacker News API
seed.description: Official, read-only Firebase-backed API for Hacker News: top, new and best stories, comments, users and full item trees. Unauthenticated and free.
seed.free_tier: Completely free with no API key; backed by Firebase with nearly unlimited read access.
features: Top, new, best and ask/show story feeds
Full comment trees for every item
use_cases: Tech news readers with custom filtering
Trend trackers for keywords across the community
Comment thread analyzers and discussion dashboards
Slack or Discord bots posting top stories

seed.name: TheSpaceDevs (Launch Library 2)
seed.description: Comprehensive spaceflight API covering upcoming rocket launches, spaceflight events, astronauts, space stations and spacecraft. Free tier available with rate limits.
seed.free_tier: Free without registration at 15 requests per hour; free API token raises this to 3,000 requests per hour.
features: Upcoming and past rocket launch schedules
Launch provider, rocket and pad details
use_cases: Launch countdown widgets and calendars
Spaceflight news aggregators with live webcasts
Astronaut and mission profile databases
Notification bots for upcoming rocket launches

seed.name: NASA APIs
seed.description: Official NASA data APIs: Astronomy Picture of the Day, Mars rover photos, Earth imagery, near-Earth objects, EPIC satellite images and more. Free API key available instantly.
seed.free_tier: Free with a DEMO_KEY for immediate testing (30 requests per IP per hour) and free personal keys (50 requests per hour).
features: Instant free API key by email
use_cases: Daily space picture widgets using APOD
Mars mission photo explorers
Asteroid tracking dashboards for educators
Earth imagery visualizations for geography projects

seed.name: Free Dictionary API
seed.description: Simple, fast dictionary API returning definitions, phonetics, audio pronunciations, synonyms and antonyms for English words. No authentication required.
seed.free_tier: Completely free with no API key; no hard rate limit published, reasonable use expected.
features: Word definitions with parts of speech
use_cases: Instant word lookup browser extensions
Vocabulary learning apps with audio pronunciations
Reading assistants that define selected text
Word-of-the-day widgets for websites

seed.name: Open Library API
seed.description: Open Library by the Internet Archive offers free APIs for books: search, metadata, covers, reading logs and full-text search across millions of works.
seed.free_tier: Completely free for reading data; accounts are free if write access (reading logs, lists) is needed.
features: Full-text search across millions of books
No API key required for reads
use_cases: Book catalog and reading list apps
Library search tools with cover art
Book recommendation widgets by subject
Citation and metadata helpers for writers

seed.name: Nager.Date
seed.description: Worldwide public holiday API covering 100+ countries: national holidays, long weekends, and next-upcoming holidays. Free and unauthenticated.
seed.free_tier: Completely free with no API key or registration.
use_cases: Holiday-aware scheduling in HR and payroll software
Long-weekend trip planners
International shipping date estimators
Calendar integrations that flag public holidays

seed.name: TheDogAPI
seed.description: Dog pictures and breed information API: thousands of curated images with temperament, life span, origin and weight data for hundreds of breeds. Free tier with optional key.
seed.free_tier: Free tier with up to 10,000 requests per month; a free API key unlocks voting, favourites and uploads.
features: Favourites and voting on free tier
Works without a key for basic use
use_cases: Breed guide apps with temperament and care info
Random dog image widgets for mood boosters
Pet adoption site enhancements
Animal-themed game content generators

seed.name: ipify
seed.description: Simple public IP address API that returns the caller's IPv4 or IPv6 address in plain text, JSON or JSONP. Handles billions of requests daily with no limits.
seed.free_tier: Completely free with no request limits and no API key.
features: Plain text, JSON and JSONP output
use_cases: Network diagnostics tools that show the visitor's IP
License validation tied to network identity
Webhook configuration helpers
Security audit logging of client addresses

seed.name: Alpha Vantage
seed.description: Stock market, forex and cryptocurrency data API with historical and intraday time series, technical indicators and fundamental data. Free API key tier available.
seed.free_tier: Free API key with 25 requests per day; premium plans raise limits.
use_cases: Stock portfolio trackers with historical charts
Technical indicator analysis for trading dashboards
Crypto price widgets for finance sites
Fundamental data screens for research tools

seed.name: CoinGecko
seed.description: Cryptocurrency market data API: prices, market caps, historical charts, exchanges and trending coins across thousands of assets. Free public tier available.
seed.free_tier: Free public tier without a key at roughly 5-15 calls per minute (30 calls/minute with a free demo key).
features: Prices and market data for 10,000+ coins
use_cases: Crypto portfolio trackers with live prices
Market cap ranking pages and widgets
Trending coin feeds for trading communities
Historical price charts for research reports
